# volcano_project_auth_methods (Resource)

Which sign-in methods are enabled for a project. Singleton - no create/delete endpoint; Create performs the first PUT and Delete is a local no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project_auth_methods" "example" {
  project_id            = volcano_project.example.id
  enable_email_password = true
  enable_anonymous      = false

  oauth_providers = [
    { provider = "google", enabled = true },
    { provider = "github", enabled = false },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `enable_anonymous` (Boolean)
- `enable_email_password` (Boolean)
- `oauth_providers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth_providers))

### Read-Only

- `available_methods` (List of String) Every sign-in method the project could enable.

<a id="nestedatt--oauth_providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth_providers`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `provider` (String) e.g. google, github, microsoft, apple.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project_auth_methods.example <project-id>
```
